facts.fact: The Presidency states SIGFIP was officially launched on 15 January 2026, centralises state financial flows, integrates the financial agencies on one platform and covers the budget chain from programming to payment.
SIGFIP, supplied under a convention signed on 31 May 2024 with IKA Technology, was officially launched on 15 January 2026; the document does not say which system it replaced.
